name: application-question-type-palette
title: Question Type Palette
description: A survey/form-builder palette of draggable question-type cards — Multiple Choice, Rating, Short Text, and Scale — each with a distinct icon and label.
useWhen: Building a survey or form editor where users add new questions by dragging or clicking a question-type card.
The set of question types benefits from a visual, icon-led picker rather than a plain dropdown.
avoidWhen: You're building a generic filter/condition builder — `Query Builder` fits structured condition rows better than question types.
There's only one question type available — a single 'Add question' button is simpler than a type palette.
responsiveBehavior: The palette is a 2-column grid at the reference width; drop to a single column on narrow sidebars while keeping each card's icon and label together.
accessibility: Each question-type card is a real <button>, keyboard-reachable and operable without a pointer, with both an icon and a text label.
Icon colors are decorative category cues; the text label is the source of truth for each type's identity.
In a real drag-and-drop implementation, provide an equivalent click-to-add or keyboard-operable insertion path alongside dragging.

variants.title: Type grid
variants.description: A 2x2 grid of draggable question-type cards (Multiple choice, Rating, Short text, Scale 1–5), each with a distinct colored icon chip and label.
accessibility: Each card is a real button with both an icon and a text label.

variants.title: Type grid (Dark)
variants.description: Question type palette adapted for dark surfaces, with icon chip colors re-tuned for dark contrast.
accessibility: Card borders, icon chips, and labels all meet WCAG AA contrast against the dark card background.
